name: Xiaomi CyberOne
summary: Xiaomi's full-size humanoid, first shown in 2022; a second generation appeared in August 2026 and is still a prototype under test in Xiaomi's own car factory. No sales offer exists.

germany.statusNote: Xiaomi shows CyberOne at trade fairs (IFA Berlin, September 2026) and tests it in its own car factory, but it is still a prototype with no price or sales route anywhere.

notes: Xiaomi publishes no manipulation or payload data; recorded with 0 working arms.

evidence.task: Self-tapping nut loading and material box handling on a car production line
evidence.note: Xiaomi's own factory and Xiaomi's own figures, for the second-generation robot. Factory work, not construction. The date is when Lei Jun said the robot entered the factory; the report later gives 98% for this station.
